brand.name: Maruti Suzuki
brand.tagline: Indian carmaker, majority-owned by Suzuki Motor Corporation, selling cars since 1983
brand.description: Founded in 1981 as Maruti Udyog Limited, a Government of India company; Suzuki Motor Corporation became a partner in 1982 and is now the majority shareholder. Production began in 1983 with the Maruti 800. Plants are in Gurugram, Manesar and Kharkhoda (Haryana) and Hansalpur (Gujarat). Cars are sold through two retail channels, Arena and NEXA.
